recent_output_link_diagnostic.limitations: An observable output-link diagnostic, not the internal Hungarian candidate selected or actual model candidate coverage. scene1_training_head_stability.scope: fixed scene1 complete-video TRAIN-head observations at inference seed20261014; does not complete any missing five-scene trial

geometry_attribution.scope: complete TRAIN-head20261014 strict5 causal B5 feature-only versus B7 joint at inference seed20261014, matched frozen model/data/head/features/scheduler/budgets; exact image/box/score/class/track ID and row order
geometry_attribution.conclusion: No observed independent geometry effect on any serialized output in this complete TRAIN-head suite.
geometry_attribution.limitations: one trained head per report; not by itself three-seed ablation, validated GT pose accuracy, proof all geometry is useless, internal-state equality or speed parity; valid geometry means numerical/background gate only

causal_mechanism_conclusions: Scene1 has large GT boxes (4151/4395 raw target rows cover16+ centers); scenes18/19 mostly0–3 centers. This is association, not a controlled resolution effect.
Complete actual solver evidence exists for scene1 only; other scenes cannot establish whether candidate coverage, detector misses or visual scoring dominate.
Scene1 gains are not stable over training heads: one seed harms CVIDF1 despite fewer IDSW. Pooled fixed-head inference-RNG trials also include a negative delta.
B5 features and B7 geometry have exactly identical final predictions in all5 scenes for the primary head. Prior gains do not establish a geometry mechanism.
Past GT-matched output-anchor diagnostics may skip unmatched observations. They are linear-query diagnostics and must not be relabeled actual solver errors or pure history coverage.
Original GMT backbone saw original TRAIN including DEV5; these results do not establish unseen-scene generalization.
